fixtures.title: Multiline headers share the lifeline start
acceptance: Bottom-align measured headers.

fixtures.title: Bounded long phase title can determine phase height
acceptance: Wrap at stored metrics with hard-token fallback.
No ellipsis.
Phase height is max(event ink + 16, title height + 16), so an oversized title never overlaps the next phase.

The continuous shaft still reaches the original endpoints.
